svg.title: How the work connects
svg.desc: FMCG retailer and wholesaler, 2019 to 2025: project 1, Inventory Gap Analysis (diagnose); its findings fed the requirements of project 2, Multi-Branch ERP (implement); the ERP became the source of stock and prices for project 3, B2B E-commerce (extend). Construction and transportation, 2025 to now: project 4, ERP Readiness Assessment (diagnose), the same diagnostic method in a new industry; vendor evaluation in progress.

g.text: ERP became the source of stock
